headline: Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings Limited discloses substantial acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: RIHL files Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding substantial acquisition in/takeover of Network18 Media & Investments Limited. Filing signals mandatory public disclosure phase under SEBI Takeover Regulations following crossing of materiality thresholds in shareholding.
detail: Reliance Industrial Investments and Holdings Limited (RIHL), a subsidiary of Reliance Industries Limited, has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the National Stock Exchange of India. The disclosure follows acquisition of shares in Network18 Media & Investments Limited, triggering the 25% threshold or other materiality markers that invoke public disclosure and open offer obligations. Network18 operates as a diversified media conglomerate (television, digital, news). The filing formalizes Reliance's entry into the mandatory offer phase and is available on NSE's corporate action archives.
